entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A false god who commands her followers to rise and destroy enemies.

entities.name: Varv
entities.description: A goblin who burned his home, weapons and killed his friend Furt in rage.

entities.name: Furt
entities.description: A goblin killed by his friend Varv.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A druid who again felt the Mirari's pull.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact with a strong pull on Kamahl.

entities.name: Raven Guild
entities.description: A guild that seeks refuge with the Cabal in Aphetto.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: A project whose grounds are now populated by slivers.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A forest whose ancient carvings glow again.

entities.name: Daru Plains
entities.description: Plains where midnight looked like sunrise.

events.summary: The Skirk Ridge collapses and goblins build a rope system to hold it.
events.quote: After the Skirk Ridge collapsed, the goblins erected a system of ropes and pulleys to hold up what was left.

events.summary: Varv destroys his home and weapons in rage and kills his friend Furt.
events.quote: Only when the anger passed did Varv realize he had burned down his home, destroyed his weapons, and killed his friend Furt.

events.summary: Kamahl feels the full force of the Mirari's pull once again.
events.quote: Once again, Kamahl felt the full force of the Mirari's pull, but he had learned much since the last time.

events.summary: The Riptide Project's grounds are now populated only by slivers.
events.quote: The grounds of the Riptide Project are now populated only by slivers, broken beakers, and the lonely screeching of gulls.

events.summary: Goblins pour from Skirk Ridge like lava.
events.quote: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.
